title: 6 Pcs Cheese Cloths for Straining, 20x20 Inch Grade 100 Precut Cheese Cloth With Hemmed Edge, 100% Cotton Unbleached, Reusable Muslin Cheesecloth for Straining, Making Yogurt, Juice, Cooking Turkey
description:
【𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐂𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐡 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐞】The 20x20 inch large-size cheese cloth for straining is pre-cut so you don't have to cut it by hand again. And it is vacuum-packed, which saves a lot of space and EARTH-FRIENDLY, ensures cleanliness and freshness
【𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐇𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞】As a must-have in the kitchen, besides making cheese, yogurt, Jelly, butter and jams, It is very suitable for making various types of milk like almond milk, oat milk, nut milk cashew milk, and it is also a great tool for straining, cooking,cold brewing, roasting turkey, fermenting baking and juicing
【𝟏𝟎𝟎% 𝐔𝐧𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐨𝐧】Each cheese cloth is crafted from 100% cotton to be chemical-free, dye-free, and we choose to be unbleached to ensure they are pure and safe without any color contamination to your food
【𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝟏𝟎𝟎 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐖𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐝】Our premium pastry cloth are carefully woven with grade 100 standard. With a high density of up to 46 x 54 yarns per inch, an evenly distributed mesh ensures a stable flow rate and efficient filtration capacity
【𝐇𝐞𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐝 𝐄𝐝𝐠𝐞 & 𝐑𝐞𝐮𝐬𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞】As a reusable strainer for juicing, it can be reused by washing and drying with water after use. It has sewn hem edges to ensure that the tensioning cloth is durable, has no threads and prevents easy tearing
